chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Ahmad ibn Hisham al-Mu'addab (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Zakariyya al-Qattan narrated to us. He said: Bakr ibn Abdullah ibn Habib narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Ubaydullah narrated to me. He said: Ali ibn al-Hakam narrated to us from Hisham, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir, from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said to Ali (peace be upon him):

O Ali! Your love will not settle in the heart of a believing person, then his foot slips on the Path (Sirat), except that a footing will be made firm for him until God the Mighty and Majestic enters him into Paradise through your love.

key_terms.الجنة: Paradise — the final abode of the righteous
key_terms.الصراط: The Sirat — the bridge over Hellfire in Islamic eschatology, which all souls must traverse on Judgment Day
key_terms.حبك: Your love — refers to love for Imam Ali (AS), here understood as part of wilayah (devotion to the Imams)
key_terms.قدمه: His foot/footing — metaphor for one's standing and passage on the Sirat

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the love of Ali and its effect on Judgment Day?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated through a chain ascending to Imam al-Baqir (AS) and his forefathers, records the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) addressing Imam Ali (AS) directly. The Prophet declares that love for Ali (AS) is a source of divine protection on the Day of Judgment: whenever a believer who harbors this love stumbles on the Sirat (the bridge over Hellfire that all must cross), God will grant him firm footing and ultimately admit him to Paradise through that love. This teaching underscores the Shia understanding of walaya (devotion to the Imams) as a saving virtue in eschatological terms, and was cherished in early Shia communities as a guarantee of divine mercy for those sincere in their love of Ahlulbayt.
word_analysis: al-Baqir (the one who splits knowledge open)

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ibrahim b. Ahmad b. Hisham al-Mu’addab (ra) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Yahya b. Zakariyya al-Qattan narrated to us. He said: Bakr b. `Abdullah b. Habib narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Ubaydullah narrated to me. He said: `Ali b. al-Hakam narrated to us from Hisham from Abi Hamza al-Thumali from Abi Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali al-Baqir from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said to `Ali (as):
O `Ali! Your love will not settle in the heart of a believing person except that his feet will be settled upon the Path until Allah enters him into Paradise by your love.
